findings.passage: “Even four years after the administrative failures of the 2020 General Election, Pennsylvania has not taken the necessary steps to reform or improve our election laws comprehensively,” said Bernstine.
findings.note: Press release announcing his election bill package; he says state election laws need broad reform.

findings.passage: Verification would include the last four digits of the applicant’s Social Security number and their Pennsylvania Department of Transportation driver’s license or identification card number, ensuring only qualified electors participate in elections.
findings.note: Release text issued in his name describing his bill to have counties check a registration applicant's Social Security digits and driver's license or state ID number within 96 hours.

findings.passage: “We need to send a clear message to everyone! If you jeopardize or cast doubt on our elections, you will face justice,” said Bernstine.
findings.note: Quote supporting his bill for a $50,000 fine and 30-day minimum jail term for each fraudulent vote.
